name: a comet streak draws a familiar mark from total darkness
looks: Total black holds for a beat, then a warm ember-coloured comet streaks diagonally across the frame, its glow tracing the stroke of a simple two-letter mark as it passes. The mark settles, glowing softly, and a short line of caption text fades in beneath it saying the viewer assumed this symbol only meant one familiar thing.
build: A particle/canvas comet (seeded points with a tapering tail) travels a path that doubles as the mark's stroke (SVG dasharray reveal timed to the comet's pass); once the stroke completes, the mark holds with a soft outer glow (box-shadow/blur layer); a caption line fades/rises in beneath it after a short pause.
sound: A rising riser under the comet's pass, a soft low hit as the mark settles, a quiet intake under the caption.
prompt: Open on total darkness, then let a warm streak of light cross the frame and, in passing, draw the stroke of a simple, familiar mark. Hold the mark glowing alone, then fade in a short line of text that names the one thing everyone already assumes this symbol means -- set up the assumption before you break it.
